note: Palestine, read on 2026-10-31 on the Palestinian Ministry of Interior's site (moi.pna.ps, Ramallah), the page of its General Directorate of Residences and Foreigners' Affairs. The Directorate grants residence to foreigners wishing to reside in the West Bank and organises foreigners' entry, exit and residence there; it receives residence applications from foreigners and visitors through the Interior directorates in the northern governorates (the West Bank) and makes the correspondence needed to obtain residence (written as one `general` route, applied for in the country). The page names no kinds of residence, fee, term, renewal or work right, and says nothing of Gaza. That the correspondence is with Israel's COGAT, whose 2022 procedure for foreigners' entry and residence in the West Bank governs visas and permits there, isn't on the page and isn't written; the procedure itself (HaMoked's copy) wasn't read.

sources.title: Palestinian Ministry of Interior: الإدارة العامة للإقامات وشؤون الأجانب
sources.said: وتختص الإدارة بمنح الإقامة للأجانب الراغبين في الإقامة في الضفة الغربية . ... الهدف العام للإدارة تنظيم دخول وخروج وإقامة الأجانب في الضفة الغربية . ... استقبال المعاملات وطلبات الإقامة من الأجانب والزائرين إلى الضفة الغربية من خلال كافة مديريات الداخلية في المحافظات الشمالية وإجراء المراسلات اللازمة للحصول على الإقامة داخل الضفة الغربية .
